globalPassCriteria: Research Plan precedes research and covers all ten dimensions.
All six Research Protocol passes are evidenced in order.
Every core option has a contradiction search.
At least one materially different alternative is assessed.
A-D sources have real direct URLs and honest grades; inference is Grade E.
Blockers and Unknowns are explicit; cost and effort are sourced, assumed, or UNKNOWN.
No verdict is issued before every stopping criterion is met.
forbiddenClaims: Invented URL, source, quote, price, platform capability, or legal conclusion.
One-search conclusion with no contradiction or alternative pass.
GO while a blocker Unknown remains.
